# daily-research

> An autonomous research feedback engine that runs inside the operator's research repositories. Every morning at 05:00, macOS launchd runs Claude Code (`claude -p`) for one rotation-picked research line plus every `daily = true` line, each with the line's repo as the working directory. Seven lines map 1:1 to research repos: `akc` (agent-knowledge-cycle), `contemplative` (contemplative-agent), `aap` (agent-attribution-practice), `authorship` (authorship-strategy), `ans` (attention-not-self), `desire` (desire-frontier), `edge` (edge-frontier; the daily line since ADR-0013). Per line, call 1 (Opus, 25-min cap) reads the repo's own operational context, picks one external development relevant to the repo, and writes an explanatory note — what happened, why it matters, what it means for this repo — to an Obsidian vault; call 2 (Sonnet, fresh context, 15-min cap, fail-open) revises it for first-contact readability. Notes carry no proposals or approval requests; the only fixed sections are a deadline-only 機会メモ tail and ソース. Bash orchestration with prompt files; JSON/TOML parsing in stdlib python3 (no pip dependencies, no orchestration framework).

## Core documentation

- [Full AI Reference](llms-full.txt): self-contained project facts, Q&A, and glossary for AI agents — read this first
- [README](README.md): human-facing narrative (English)
- [README (日本語)](README.ja.md): human-facing narrative (Japanese)
- [Project & contributor guide](CLAUDE.md): how the system is structured and how to work in this repo

## Architecture

- [ADR-0014](docs/adr/0014-trend-explanation-report.md): report = one external development explained + implications for the repo; adversarial framing (corroboration ban, mandatory refutation, premise-challenge pass, scoring_criteria) retired — the current objective function
- [ADR-0010](docs/adr/0010-rotation-and-two-tier-eval.md): one rotated line per morning + two-tier in-loop eval (theme screen in call 1, fresh-context clarity revision in call 2) — the current execution shape
- [ADR-0011](docs/adr/0011-daily-line.md) / [ADR-0013](docs/adr/0013-edge-daily-line.md): `daily = true` lines run every day outside the rotation; partial-failure semantics (OK / E_PARTIAL / E_NO_REPORT); `edge` is the daily line
- [ADR-0009](docs/adr/0009-explanatory-report-and-brief-retirement.md): explanatory reports instead of actionable-tactics notes; the 07:00 Slack approval brief retired
- [ADR-0008](docs/adr/0008-per-repo-in-context-research.md): per-repo in-context research (cwd = the repo); retires the concept-graph-driven theme selection
- [ADR-0006](docs/adr/0006-self-improvement-loop-human-consumer.md): self-improvement loop (report gate ctl-015, deterministic lint ctl-016, metrics.jsonl, /dr-review) — no LLM judge
- [ADR-0001](docs/adr/0001-research-repo-feedback-engine.md): why lines map to research repositories (historical origin); full index in [docs/adr/README.md](docs/adr/README.md) (0001–0014)
- [Per-repo research protocol](prompts/repo-research-protocol.md): call 1 — objective function, diff-first pass, 3-question theme selection, citation gate
- [Clarity review protocol](prompts/clarity-review-protocol.md): call 2 — defect detection only, no new facts, sources / 機会メモ / frontmatter untouched
- [Report template](templates/report-template.md): three writing rules + recommended four-part shape + the two fixed tail sections (機会メモ / ソース)
- [Main entry point](scripts/daily-research.sh): rotation-pick, per-line call 1 + call 2, retry, report gate, lint, metrics; `--allowedTools` path-scoped writes plus a `--disallowedTools Bash,Task,NotebookEdit` deny layer
- [Parsing module](scripts/lib/dr_pipeline.py): stdlib-only JSON/TOML — rotation-pick, line-brief, past-themes, report-lint, metrics-append, expect-check

## Operations

- [RUNBOOK](docs/RUNBOOK.md): monitoring, log messages, troubleshooting, common issues

- [Skill manifest](SKILL.md): install the repo as a Claude Code skill (`/daily-research`)

## Data

- [graph.jsonld](graph.jsonld): FROZEN archive — the retired concept-cluster graph of the pre-ADR-0008 pipeline; receives no more increments ([schema](docs/graph-schema.md))
- [metrics.example.jsonl](metrics.example.jsonl): shape of one `metrics.jsonl` record (pass1 null, pass2 = summed call-1 runs, clarity_pass, lint)
